posts.title: Castform Weather Charm amigurumi
posts.description: I was really inspired by the Castform Weather Charm object in Pokopia, and wanted to make a crochet version. Here's my pattern for crocheting a wall hanging amigurumi that is about 9.5 inch/24.1 cm tall, 7 inch/17.8 cm wide, and 3.25 inch/8.3 cm deep. (It's my first ever amigurumi pattern!) posts.title: Modifications to add a booty to Loops by Kat's Ditto amigurumi
posts.description: I found a wonderful free crochet pattern for the Pokémon Ditto from Loops by Kat , but I decided I wanted to make a version with more than 3 "leg" blobs like the original pattern had. Specifically, I wanted to add two more smaller blobs in the back to help stabilize Ditto when they're sitting and also add a butt to our favorite transforming blob. posts.title: Lily pad mini quilt
posts.description: While on a short road trip and then recovering from surgery, I hand quilted and hand embroidered a linen lily pad quilt. And yes, I did make this little quilt for my Frinos plush from Hades II to have a nice place to rest.
